<DOCSTRING>
Checks and enforces the validity of an email label according to RFC 5322 and RFC 952.

Args:
    label (str): The email label to validate.
    start_descr (str): The description for the start of the label.
    end_descr (str): The description for the end of the label.
    is_hostname (bool): Whether the label is treated as a hostname.

Raises:
    EmailSyntaxError: If the label violates the specified rules.
</DOCSTRING>
